topics.name: IdentityCore Approval Evidence
topics.purpose: Define verification/approval evidence for person/organization identity attributes and claims without turning unverified self-assertion into canonical verified fact.

semantics.identity_rule: Approval evidence has its own explicit identity.
semantics.target_rule: Approval targets exact IdentityCore identity and claim/attribute.
semantics.claim_rule: Unapproved claim remains distinct from verified attribute.
semantics.authority_rule: Approval evidence does not automatically grant AccessCore authority.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

references.purpose: Approval evidence targets exact canonical identities.
